t: The Storage Scanner scans nearby inventories and shows their contents in one GUI. You can search, request items, and insert items back into connected inventories.
存储检测器可扫描附近物品栏，并在一个GUI界面中集中展示其内容。你可进行搜索、请求物品，或向已连接的物品栏回填物品。
Use the radius slider and Scan button to find inventories. With XNet integration configured as required, scanner range is controlled by XNet connections instead.
使用半径滑块与扫描按钮查找物品栏。若已按要求配置XNet集成，则扫描范围将由XNet连接决定，而非本机设置。
The search box filters by item name. Prefix a term with @ to filter by mod id, such as @minecraft or @rftoolsstorage.
搜索框按物品名称进行筛选。在关键词前添加@符号可按模组ID筛选，例如@minecraft或@rftoolsstorage。
Inventories can be moved, removed, marked routable, and sorted. Routable inventories are used for automated insert/extract behavior and starred module views.
物品栏可被移动、移除、标记为可路由，或排序。可路由物品栏将用于自动化插/取行为及带星标模块视图。
For remote use, link a $(l:rftoolsbase:scanner/modules)Storage Control Module$(/l) to the scanner and install it in a $(l:rftoolsbase:scanner/remote)Tablet Scanner$(/l).
如需远程使用，请将$(l:rftoolsbase:scanner/modules)存储控制模块$(/l)链接至检测器，并安装至$(l:rftoolsbase:scanner/remote)平板电脑（检测器）$(/l)中。
